graph.title: Off Road Fire Rescue (7942-1)

new_part_types.name: Container door with fire logo (dark grey)

notes: Two builds: pickup truck (steps 1-17) and trailer with pump gadget (trailer steps 1-16), plus the minifig built on page 2. Ids b1.. are in build order; trailer wheel holders are b62/b64.

Pieces are shown only as pictures; exact stud-to-stud placement is inferred. Catalogue parts have only one generic stud/anti-stud port each, so where several pieces join the same base piece (or the same port would be reused) the shared side's port is left null instead of reusing a single-use port.
Minifig joins (torso-legs, tanks-torso) use null ports because no compatible port kinds are defined; the seated minifig on the yellow plate is a contact edge.

Minifig legs: the inventory prints 9339 for the black legs, which is not a valid LEGO part number (nor is the design id 970c00 accepted), so the catalogue's real black legs part lego-6005225 (black legs with hip/seat) is used as the closest match.
Walkie-talkie to roof, tow-ball cap to tow bar and the red clip pieces to their side-stud bricks use null ports (clip joins with no matching catalogue port).

Pieces whose element ID is not in the catalogue were added as new types from the inventory page (459901, 4193479, 408521, 255521, 362321, 4191116, 4260036, 383824, 4211080, 4211039, 4210888, 4215740, 4261469, 4263176, 4211370, 4272037, 383526, 258426, 4113106, 4262022, 4275338); their function is inferred from the pictures.

Inventory counts used: 241201 x9 (truck bumper 2, truck light bar 2, trailer rack 4, pump gadget 1 - split inferred); 4211398 x5; 255521 x5; 408521 x2 (truck pillars); 4524644 x1 used as red tow-ball cap.
The trailer coupling to the truck is a contact edge between the tow bar and the truck tailgate.

The air tanks (383824) are placed on the trailer tray in trailer step 14 and then worn by the minifig in the final picture; they are modelled on the minifig. Placement of 4272037 and 4113106 is uncertain.

graph_initial.title: Off Road Fire Rescue (7942-1)

new_part_types.name: Container door with fire logo (dark grey)

notes: Two builds: pickup truck (steps 1-17) and trailer with pump gadget (trailer steps 1-16), plus the minifig built on page 2. Ids b1.. are in build order, but wheel holders for the trailer are b62/b64 and the sub-assemblies are listed in build order across truck then trailer then gadget.
Many pieces are shown only as pictures; exact stud-to-stud placement is inferred. Ports on stacking edges are generic (stud.1/anti-stud.1) and do not indicate specific stud positions.

Pieces whose element ID is not in the catalogue were added as new types from the inventory page (459901, 4193479, 408521, 255521, 362321, 4191116, 4260036, 383824, 4211080, 4211039, 4210888, 4215740, 4261469, 4263176, 4211370, 4272037, 383526, 258426, 4113106, 4262022, 4275338). Their identity/function is inferred from the pictures.

Inventory counts used: 241201 x9 (truck bumper 2, truck light bar 2, trailer rack 4, pump gadget 1 - split inferred); 4211398 x5; 255521 x5 (pump gadget 5 incl. lever); 408521 x2 (truck pillars); 4524644 x1 used as red tow-ball cap on trailer tow bar.
The trailer coupling to the truck is shown as a contact edge between the tow bar and the truck tailgate (the final picture shows the trailer behind the truck).
The air tanks (383824) are placed on the trailer tray in trailer step 14 and then worn by the minifig in the final picture; they are modelled on the minifig (neck port shared with the head).
The minifig is shown seated in the truck cab (legs on the yellow 2x2 plate); the fire tool 383526 is held in the minifig's hand. 4272037 and 4113106 placements are uncertain.
Instruction page 22 inventory also lists a few parts whose steps are not clearly shown; they were attached at the most plausible position.
